title: Process Review
briefing: Two stocks, one surprise you cannot predict. Size every position so that no single bad day can sink you, and use stops.
objective: Judge decisions by process: sensible size and stops protect you from outcomes you cannot foresee.
debrief: Lumen Bikes climbed steadily all match. On day 18, Meadow Pharma's drug trial failed without warning and the stock gapped down 15% overnight, straight through any stop placed within 15% of the price. Nobody could have known. Players who had capped each position and used stops took a bruise; anyone with most of their money in Meadow took a serious loss. Good process could not prevent the bad news, but it decided how much it cost.

news.headline: Meadow Pharma's late-stage drug trial fails
news.body: The medicine did not work better than a placebo. The company will stop the program.

basic.text: Keep every position at or under 25% of your portfolio

bonus.text: Keep your worst drop within your plan's maximum loss
